features.description: A large southern Marshallese atoll with a squarish lagoon and a long tail extending to the southeast. Its WWII Japanese garrison was cut off and starved during the war.
features.look_for: Square-ish atoll with a tail

features.name: Salar de Atacama
features.description: A 3,000 km² rough grey-white salt nucleus in the Atacama; its brine holds about a quarter of the world's lithium reserves.
features.look_for: Textured pale salt crust ringed by brown desert

features.name: Seymour Island
features.description: A small snow-free brown island in the Weddell Sea whose fossil beds record the end of the dinosaurs; nicknamed the "Rosetta Stone" of Antarctic paleontology.
features.look_for: Brown snow-free island

features.name: Khor Al Adaid
features.description: Qatar's 'Inland Sea', a turquoise tidal lagoon reaching deep into the desert, surrounded by high dunes. One of the few places where sand dunes meet the sea.
features.look_for: Turquoise lagoon in dunes

features.name: Samosir Island
features.description: A large island inside the caldera of the Toba supervolcano, whose eruption 74,000 years ago was the largest in 2 million years. Samosir is an uplifted resurgent dome.
features.look_for: Large island within a huge caldera lake

features.name: Tubbataha Reef
features.description: Two remote atolls in the middle of the Sulu Sea, with turquoise lagoons ringed by reef - one of the best-protected marine parks on Earth.
features.look_for: Two turquoise atolls in deep blue sea

verified.note: recentered on reefs south-east of first center

features.name: Sete Cidades
features.description: A 5 km caldera on São Miguel cradling twin lakes, one blue and one green, linked by a narrow strait.
features.look_for: Round caldera with twin lakes of different colours

features.name: Prince of Wales Icefield
features.description: Ellesmere Island's southern ice field, about 20,000 km2, drained by fast outlet glaciers into the North Water polynya region.
features.look_for: Ice field spilling outlet glaciers into Baffin Bay

features.name: Nukufetau
features.description: A squarish Tuvaluan atoll whose pale reef rim encloses a deep blue lagoon dotted with coral heads. American forces built a bomber airfield on its Motulalo islet in 1943.
features.look_for: Square reef ring with scattered lagoon heads

features.name: Campo de Piedra Pómez
features.description: A field of wind-sculpted white pumice towers from the Cerro Blanco eruption, gleaming against dark Puna lava.
features.look_for: White streaky field in dark terrain

features.name: Toshka Lakes
features.description: A chain of four lakes that suddenly filled a dry desert depression in the late 1990s when Lake Nasser overflowed through a spillway. They have been shrinking ever since.
features.look_for: Dark lakes strung across desert

features.name: Bassas da India
features.description: A perfectly formed atoll in the Mozambique Channel that is submerged at high tide, its pale turquoise lagoon contrasting with deep blue water.
features.look_for: Bright turquoise ring in deep blue

features.name: Dầu Tiếng Reservoir
features.description: One of Vietnam's largest artificial lakes, a splayed irregular reservoir among rubber plantations northwest of Ho Chi Minh City.
features.look_for: Irregular reservoir in plantation country

features.name: Loch Lomond
features.description: Britain's largest lake by area, broad and island-studded in the south, narrowing into a fjord-like trench in the north.
features.look_for: Lake wide with islands at one end, thin at the other

features.name: Las Médulas
features.description: The largest Roman gold mine: hills collapsed by hydraulic mining left red-orange pinnacles among chestnut woods.
features.look_for: Orange eroded patch in green hills

verified.note: orange patch NW of wiki point

features.name: Mount Vesuvius
features.description: The volcano that buried Pompeii, a grey cone nested inside the older Somma rim, surrounded by suburbs of Naples.
features.look_for: Crater cone with a semicircular outer rim amid city

verified.note: cone and Somma rim amid city

features.name: Arabat Spit
features.description: One of the world's longest spits, a 110 km sand strip, only 270 m wide in places, separating the Sivash from the Sea of Azov.
features.look_for: Very long thin sand strip between colourful lagoon and sea

features.name: Craters of the Moon
features.description: A 1,600 km2 sea of basalt lava flows along the Great Rift, as recent as 2,000 years old, on the Snake River Plain.
features.look_for: Black lava flows spilling across a brown plain

features.name: Cuatro Ciénegas
features.description: An oasis of hundreds of spring-fed pools (pozas) with ancient microbial mats and stromatolites; NASA studies it as an analog of early Earth.
features.look_for: White gypsum dunes and blue spring pools in a desert basin

features.name: Osprey Reef
features.description: An isolated oceanic reef in the Coral Sea, a narrow ring surrounding a deep lagoon, rising from 2,000 m depths. It is famous among divers for shark encounters.
features.look_for: Lone elongated reef ring in deep blue

features.name: Wayag (Raja Ampat)
features.description: A cluster of green karst islets and turquoise lagoons in Raja Ampat, at the heart of the Coral Triangle. It is the most famous postcard view of the islands.
features.look_for: Clustered green karst islets

verified.note: karst islet cluster (rc1; source coord sign fixed)

features.name: Ontong Java Atoll
features.description: One of the largest atolls in the world, a boomerang-shaped ring of reef and islets 70 km long. It gives its name to a huge undersea plateau.
features.look_for: Huge boomerang atoll

features.name: Wailagilala
features.description: A small horseshoe atoll in Fiji's northern Lau Group, a curving reef rim around a deep lagoon with a single sandy islet and an old lighthouse. It is uninhabited.
features.look_for: Small horseshoe reef ring

features.name: Lovozero Massif
features.description: A compact, round alkaline massif east of the Khibiny, its flat top cut by deep cirques; one of the world's richest rare-earth deposits.
features.look_for: Round bare highland beside a long lake

features.name: Korkino Coal Pit
features.description: Once Europe's deepest open-pit coal mine, a 500 m deep oval hole on the edge of Korkino town south of Chelyabinsk.
features.look_for: Deep oval pit beside a town

features.name: Carajás Mine
features.description: The world's largest iron-ore mine: rust-red pits carved into a forested plateau in the Amazon, glaringly obvious against the green.
features.look_for: Red scarred plateau in rainforest

features.name: Mount Elgon

features.look_for: Large volcano with forest ring

features.name: Mount Kenya
features.description: Africa's second-highest mountain (5,199 m), an eroded volcano whose dark forest ring stands out sharply against farmland, with snow and glaciers at the core.
features.look_for: Dark forest ring with a pale summit

features.name: Flaming Mountains
features.description: A long red sandstone ridge furrowed by gullies, rising from the Turpan basin floor. Featured in 'Journey to the West', its surface can exceed 60 C in summer.
features.look_for: Thin rust-red furrowed ridge

features.name: Mount Kailash
features.description: A strikingly symmetrical snow-capped peak sacred to four religions; its south face is scored by a vertical gully and layered bands. It has never been climbed.
features.look_for: Isolated snow-capped diamond peak

features.name: Geladandong
features.description: A glaciated massif of the Tanggula Mountains whose meltwater is the traditional source of the Yangtze River. Its glacier tongues spread like fingers onto the plateau.
features.look_for: White ice massif with finger glaciers

features.name: Singapore
features.description: A diamond-shaped city-state island ringed with reclaimed land, its southern coast a maze of container ports and anchored ships. It has grown 25% in area through reclamation.
features.look_for: Dense urban island with geometric reclaimed coast

features.name: Sorowako Nickel Mine
features.description: Huge red-orange laterite strip mines beside Lake Matano, one of the world's largest nickel operations. The red soil contrasts violently with the green forest.
features.look_for: Red-orange scarred hills by a lake

features.name: Westfjords
features.description: A hand-shaped peninsula of flat-topped basalt mountains slashed by dozens of fjords, almost an island attached by a 7 km isthmus.
features.look_for: Many-fingered peninsula of fjords and plateaus

features.name: Mount Katmai
features.description: The summit of Katmai collapsed into a 3 km caldera in 1912 when magma drained to nearby Novarupta. A turquoise lake and glaciers now fill the pit.
features.look_for: Ice-rimmed caldera holding a turquoise crater lake

features.name: Florida Keys
features.description: A 180 km chain of fossil coral islands linked by the Overseas Highway, fronted by the only living barrier reef in the continental US.
features.look_for: Long arc of low islands strung along turquoise reef flats

features.name: Boundary Waters Lakes
features.description: Over 1,000 glacial lakes in scoured Canadian Shield bedrock, a canoe wilderness straddling the Minnesota-Ontario border.
features.look_for: Forest shattered by hundreds of angular lakes

features.name: Isla Tiburón

features.look_for: Large bare mountainous island separated from the coast by a narrow strait

features.name: Otago Peninsula & Harbour
features.description: A volcanic peninsula and long narrow harbour near Dunedin. It hosts the only mainland albatross breeding colony in the world.
features.look_for: Long narrow harbour beside hilly peninsula

features.name: Bagana
features.description: A young lava cone on Bougainville, one of the most active volcanoes in Melanesia, with a bare brown-grey summit and lava flows. It has been continuously active for decades.
features.look_for: Bare brown cone with lava flows in jungle

features.name: Heard Island & Big Ben
features.description: An ice-covered active volcano, Big Ben (2,745 m), rising from the Southern Ocean; its glaciers radiate like spokes to the sea.
features.look_for: Glaciated volcano island

features.name: Kolwezi Copper-Cobalt Mines

features.look_for: Pale mine scars and pits

features.look_for: Big pale mine scar

features.name: Harrat al-Sham
features.description: The 'Black Desert': a huge field of dark basalt boulders spanning Syria, Jordan and Saudi Arabia, a dark stain covering 40,000 km².
features.look_for: Dark basalt desert

features.name: Ngoring and Gyaring Lakes

features.look_for: Two big blue lakes side by side on brown plateau

features.description: A long salt lake subdivided into ponds that turn pink, green, purple and blue depending on brine and algae. Salt has been harvested here for over 4,000 years.

features.name: Chernobyl cooling pond

features.look_for: Long rectangular embanked pond beside the river

verified.note: long embanked loop pond beside the river

features.name: Tongue of the Ocean

features.look_for: Deep blue U-shaped trench cut into turquoise shallows

features.name: Middleton Reef
features.description: A kidney-shaped coral atoll in the Tasman Sea, scattered with shipwrecks. Along with Elizabeth Reef it is among the southernmost platform reefs in the world.
features.look_for: Kidney-shaped turquoise atoll

features.name: Fakarava
features.description: The second-largest atoll in French Polynesia, a long rectangular reef ring 60 km long. It is a UNESCO biosphere reserve famous for its "wall of sharks" in the south pass.
features.look_for: Long rectangular atoll ring

features.name: Ciénaga Grande de Santa Marta
features.description: A huge coastal lagoon separated from the Caribbean by a thin barrier, with stilt villages.
features.look_for: Large lagoon behind sand strip

features.name: Los Pelambres mine
features.description: A big copper pit high in the snowy central Andes near the Argentine border; its tailings travel 50 km down-valley to the El Mauro dam.
features.look_for: Terraced grey pit among mountains

features.name: Lago Cochrane/Pueyrredón
features.description: A binational glacial lake that turns bright blue against the dry Patagonian steppe on its Argentine side.
features.look_for: Blue lake in brown steppe

features.name: Chaka Salt Lake
features.description: A mirror-like salt lake between mountain ranges east of the Qaidam, mined for salt for over 3,000 years. Its shallow brine is famous as the 'Mirror of the Sky'.

features.look_for: Chain of turquoise reefs in the sea

features.name: Limfjord
